chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Saif ibn 'Amirah from Abu Bakr from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said:
"When the time for an obligatory prayer enters, do not perform voluntary prayer."
ai.seo_question: When should voluntary prayers be performed relative to obligatory prayers?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of prioritizing the obligatory prayer over voluntary acts once its specific time has commenced, reflecting the Shia juristic consensus on the precedence of fard over nafl. It serves as a foundational text for the legal discussion regarding whether nafl prayers are prohibited (mandub or wajib) or merely discouraged (makruh) during the exact window of the obligatory prayer's onset, emphasizing spiritual focus and timely fulfillment of duty.
